title: Yummy Date Night Roast Duck Tagine
description: A delicious Egyptian-inspired dish featuring roast duck, dates, and cider. This meal is perfect for a date night or special occasion.
instructions: Season the duck with salt and black pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add the chopped onions and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and ground ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped almonds and cook for 1 minute.
Add the dates, cider, orange juice, and stock to the pot. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the duck in the oven for 30 minutes, then baste it with the juices from the pot.
Return the duck to the pot and continue roasting for another 20-25 minutes, or until the meat is cooked through and the skin is crispy.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the ground cinnamon and saffron threads.
Let the dish rest for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the duck with the sauce spooned over the top.
